newsitem.title: GERMANY: Traub to file for bankrupty, investors eye group.
newsitem.headline: Traub to file for bankrupty, investors eye group.

text.p: German machine tool maker Traub AG said on Tuesday it would be forced to file for bankruptcy after efforts to scale back debt with creditors failed, but said other companies had already shown interest in the group.

Traub, which declared itself insolvent in October, said it was not able to complete composition proceedings aimed at having creditors agree to forego some debt and therefore needed to file for bankruptcy.
Traub said that German machine tool maker Gildemeister AG and Index-Werke were interested in the group.
The company's founding family Traub van Kempen had earlier said it would be willing to part with a 27 percent stake to try to attract new investors in the firm.
